limitedTo.where: Monitor: on a wedge fader (the /monitor page and the Perform toolbar popover), shown for 3 seconds after the mixer held a move to the limit
limitedTo.context: {db} is a level such as '+2 dB'. The wedge (stage monitor) cannot go louder than the limit the sound engineer set.

capTick.where: Monitor: on a wedge fader (the /monitor page and the Perform toolbar popover): accessible label of the small tick that marks the limit on the fader
capTick.context: {db} is a level such as '+2 dB'

pausedLine.where: Perform toolbar monitor popover: shown over the last known levels when the bridge (the program on the sound PC) is not running
pausedLine.context: Michael and Drew are people's names. The bridge is the program on the sound PC that links iPads to the mixer.

busSwitcher.where: Monitor page and popover header: accessible label of the switcher shown to someone who is on two wedge buses
busSwitcher.context: bus = a mixer output feeding one wedge

busOption.where: Monitor page and popover: one choice in the bus switcher

saveMix.where: Monitor page (My Mix tab) and Perform popover: button that saves the current wedge levels under a name

recallMix.where: Monitor page (My Mix tab) and Perform popover: button that opens the list of saved mixes

mixNameLabel.where: Save-this-mix dialog: label of the name field

mixNameDate.where: Save-this-mix dialog: default name when today has no service type

saveMixHint.where: Save-this-mix dialog: one line under the title

saving.where: Save-this-mix dialog: confirm button while saving

cancel.where: Save-this-mix dialog and recall sheet: cancel button

mixSaved.where: Toast after a mix was saved

mixSaveFailed.where: Toast when saving a mix failed

recallNamed.where: Recall sheet: heading of the person's own named mixes

recallAuto.where: Recall sheet: heading of the automatic snapshots taken at the end of each service

recallLoading.where: Recall sheet and save dialog: while loading

autoName.where: Recall sheet: name of an automatic snapshot that has no name

recallChanges_one.where: Recall sheet: count of fader changes the recall will make

recallChanges_other.where: Recall sheet: count of fader changes the recall will make

recallConfirm.where: Recall sheet: the confirm button that sends the change to the mixer

recallSending.where: Recall sheet: confirm button while sending

recallNothing.where: Recall sheet: no changes to make

recallMaster.where: Recall sheet: row name for the overall wedge level
recallMaster.context: the master = overall volume of the wedge

recallMuted.where: Recall sheet: shown instead of a level for a channel that will be or was muted

recallHeld.where: Recall sheet: note on a row whose saved level is above the sound engineer's limit

recallUnmatched.where: Recall sheet: saved channels the mixer no longer has; they are left alone
recallUnmatched.context: {names} is a list of channel names

recallPartial.where: Recall sheet: the recall was cut off after some faders had moved

recallRetry.where: Recall sheet: confirm button after a recall stopped partway; finishes the recall

limitsAboveUnity.where: Limits panel: inline warning when a limit is raised above 0 dB

limitsConfirm.where: Limits panel: save button while a limit is raised above 0 dB

recallSent.where: Toast after the recall was sent

limitsTitle.where: Monitor page, Configure tab: heading of the wedge limits panel
limitsTitle.context: limit = the loudest a wedge send or master may go

limitsHint.where: Monitor page, Configure tab: one line under the Limits heading
limitsHint.context: Claude is the AI assistant; keep the name

limitSend.where: Limits panel: slider for the highest level of each channel in a wedge

limitMaster.where: Limits panel: slider for the highest overall wedge level

limitsDefault.where: Limits panel: heading of the default limits

limitsPerBus.where: Limits panel: heading of one bus's own limits

limitsOverride.where: Limits panel: switch that gives one bus its own limits instead of the defaults

limitsSaved.where: Toast after the limits were saved

limitsSaveFailed.where: Toast when saving the limits failed

engineerLink.where: Monitor page header: link to the engineer console

engineerDenied.where: Engineer console page: shown to anyone else

busTitle.where: Engineer console: card title for one wedge bus

nobodyOnBus.where: Engineer console: bus card with no one assigned

topChannels.where: Engineer console: heading of a bus card's top channels

nothingAudible.where: Engineer console: bus card where every channel is off

ride.where: Engineer console: button that opens every fader of one bus
ride.context: ride = adjust levels live during a service

rideDone.where: Engineer console: closes the open bus

bridgeTitle.where: Engineer console: heading of the bridge status card
bridgeTitle.context: the bridge = the program on the sound PC that links iPads to the mixer

bridgeRunning.where: Engineer console, bridge card: the bridge is alive

bridgeNotRunning.where: Engineer console, bridge card: the bridge has not checked in for 2 minutes

bridgeNeverSeen.where: Engineer console, bridge card: no heartbeat ever

launchReason.where: Engineer console, bridge card: what last started the bridge
launchReason.context: {reason} is one of the reason strings below

reasonWatchdog.where: Engineer console, bridge card: fills {reason}; the watchdog relaunches the bridge if it stops

launchUnknown.where: Engineer console, bridge card: an older bridge that does not report it

watchdogNo.where: Engineer console, bridge card: a warning in words

watchdogUnknown.where: Engineer console, bridge card: an older bridge that does not report it

queue_one.where: Engineer console, bridge card: commands queued for the mixer

queue_other.where: Engineer console, bridge card: commands queued for the mixer

master.where: Engineer console and limits: the overall wedge level of a bus
